name: algo-trading-platform
description: Full-stack algo trading platform (Angel One SmartAPI, Supabase, React)

scripts.dev:frontend: npm run build -w @algo/rule-schema --if-present && npm run dev -w frontend
scripts.dev:backend: npm run build -w @algo/rule-schema --if-present && npm run dev -w backend
scripts.build: npm run build -w @algo/rule-schema --if-present && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.verify: npm run verify:engine -w backend && npm run verify:live -w backend
